text: 中信股份携旗下中信证券等上市公司，首次走进上海证券交易所路演大厅，举行2026年中期业绩联合发布会。在本次联合发布会上，中信证券执行董事、总经理邹迎光，对2026年中期业绩创历史新高、以及公司完成H股定向增发进行了整体回应。
text_en: CITIC Limited, together with listed units including CITIC Securities, entered the Shanghai Stock Exchange roadshow hall for the first time to hold a joint 2026 interim results presentation. At the event, Zou Yingguang, Executive Director and General Manager of CITIC Securities, addressed the record-high 2026 interim results and the completion of the company's H-share private placement.
